alternatives.name: Databento
alternatives.why_not_default: The only evidence is an upstream README (packet line 395). There is no retained acquisition, entitlement or corporate-action receipt. Its card says the feed is exchange-specific rather than consolidated, and that redistribution is restricted. It is the natural comparison arm against c9 for gaps c9 leaves open: delisted-name coverage, dividend currency and instrument definitions. That comparison has not been run.

alternatives.name: Massive Python client
alternatives.why_not_default: README source review only, with no retained data request. Its card says the free tier does not grant commercial use or every endpoint, and that ticker filters do not prove a complete historical universe. It overlaps c9's retained native SIP bar coverage without any evidence of its own.

alternatives.name: data-fredapi
alternatives.why_not_default: Macro and vintage access is backed only by README source review; its card says no data request was run. It also has an unmaintained signal: latest release 2024-05-05 (packet line 230).

alternatives.name: data-gdeltdoc
alternatives.why_not_default: README source review only, with an unmaintained signal. Its card says GDELT first-seen time is not publication time or tradable availability time, and that results are bounded rather than exhaustive.

alternatives.name: data-feast
alternatives.why_not_default: This is a feature store for point-in-time joins, not an acquisition source, and it has README source review only. Its card says event-time retrieval does not exclude late corrections. The retained as-of selection is done by DuckDB (identity-readiness temporal_ledger), not Feast.

alternatives.name: data-dlt
alternatives.why_not_default: An ingestion framework backed only by README source review; no pipeline receipt is retained. Its card says schema inference is not a financial data-quality contract and that watermark extraction can miss revisions. Retained ingestion uses custom collectors such as alpaca-historical/collect.py.

alternatives.name: data-kafka
alternatives.why_not_default: Event-log infrastructure with README source review only; the upstream released_at is null. The packet's existing_overturn_when (line 437) says to add a server only after local throughput and concurrency measurements, and none are retained.

alternatives.name: QuestDB
alternatives.why_not_default: A time-series server backed only by README source review; its card says the catalog did not install or start a server. The card also warns that dedup/upsert can overwrite corrections. No measurement justifies it over the retained DuckDB/Parquet path, which handled 24310292 bars per adjustment in broad-universe/receipt.json.

alternatives.name: sec-api-io/sec-api-python
alternatives.why_not_default: Not adopted and has no evidence_refs. It overlaps c6, which has native SEC acquisition evidence in access-resolution.json (HTTP 200, 371 rows).

alternatives.name: atilaahmettaner/tradingview-mcp
alternatives.why_not_default: Not adopted and has no evidence_refs. The packet note describes the as-of reconciliation it would need, not an executed result.

alternatives.name: rossod4/quantlab
alternatives.why_not_default: Not adopted and has no evidence_refs. The packet note says it has 0 stars, no license and no release, and describes itself as 'in progress'.

The identity-readiness as-of gate sets availability to local observation time (manifests/evidence.json line 1289), so it rejects historical data by construction rather than reconstructing as-known state. The c6 gate likewise uses local first_observed_at.

Corporate-action reconciliation is incomplete. c9 matched both numeric action values, but 1 dividend has unknown currency (status reconciliation_incomplete), and historical_coverage_established is false (authenticated-data/native-receipt.json lines 63, 119-128).

The survivorship-free universe is not established. broad-universe limitations: only 25/47/167 symbols end in 2016/2017/2018 because the provider asset list under-enumerates delisted names; 235 undated ticker collisions remain; identity is provider-symbol based (evidence/receipts/broad-universe-research-20260921.json lines 13-15). identity-readiness gives historical_identity_established false.

Licensing and entitlement scope beyond historical SIP daily bars is not established. The receipt says there is no real-time access, unlimited history or redistribution right (authenticated-data/native-receipt.json line 223).
The c6 evidence covers one SEC index day (2020-03-02) with 5 headers. No filing-completeness claim follows.
The c13 evidence directly shows one XNYS session plus a 104-session date check. Holidays, half-days, future schedules, halts and extended hours are not established.
Macro, news, fundamentals, vintage-data and stream-ingestion scope terms have only README-level candidates (c8, c5, c10, c2). They remain unqualified.

overturn_protocol.metric:
Per provider, over the same representative securities (including delistings, ticker reuse and cash dividends): (a) the fraction of records carrying source identity, feed, page hash and a first-availability timestamp; (b) the fraction of corporate actions fully reconciled including cash currency; (c) the fraction correctly excluded at a historical as-of cutoff. Current baselines:
- c9 AAPL: bars 25/25 equal; actions numeric 2/2 equal, unknown_currency 1; historical-cutoff count 0 (identity-readiness).
- c6 SEC: eligible_count 0 of 5 at 2020-03-03T00:00:00Z and 5 of 5 at observation time.

overturn_when:
Any of these checks would change the verdict:
- c9 displaced or narrowed:
  - `python3 blueprints/us-equities/authenticated-data/compare.py` (with the --run/--receipt-sha256/--lean/--lean-sha256 arguments recorded in authenticated-data/native-receipt.json) or `blueprints/us-equities/alpaca-historical/collect.py verify` stops reproducing 25/25 equal closes, or fails its private-artifact hash verification.
  - Or a c14 Databento arm, collected into a retained blueprints/us-equities/ receipt over the same representative securities (including delisted names, ticker reuse and dividends with currency), closes the gaps c9 leaves open with auditable page hashes: under-enumerated pre-2020 delistings, 235 undated ticker collisions, and unknown dividend currency.
- c6 displaced: a re-run of blueprints/us-equities/catalyst-provenance/native_edgar.py no longer returns HTTP 200 with a hash-verified complete source, or `python3 -m unittest tests.test_catalyst_provenance` fails.
- c13 displaced: the XNYS session check in blueprints/us-equities/data/summarize_backtest.py disagrees with a verified holiday/half-day fixture.
